description: The workspace singleton read — NO arguments, and no filter param to accrete. One row carries the whole store's totals; its exists flag makes 'nothing has been counted yet' a DISTINCT state from a zero-filled row (DB19: no rows is data, not failure), and the floored cost_state keeps the grand total honest about how much of it is actually known. Component moves never touch these totals (T7's Do-NOT): a move rearranges attribution, not truth.
